thread:
noah: Hey team, just opened my assigned MBP (M2) and it immediately asked for a FileVault recovery key during OOBE. I don't have one and Kandji shows no profile. Can't proceed with Setup Assistant. Anyone seen this with refurbished devices?

sophia-it: welcome @noah. weird — if the device had an old escrowed key from a previous tenant it can prompt. can you get the serial and run `profiles status` from recovery shell? if you can't boot past OOBE, a screenshot of the recovery prompt helps.

noah: serial: C02R8G7YL4PQ. i can get to Utilities > Terminal in recovery. `profiles status` not available there. screen attached (shows "Enter recovery key to unlock disk").

it-bot: Ticket INC-2468 created and assigned to sophia-it. https://internal.redwood/support/INC-2468

sophia-it: thanks. i'll check ABM/Kandji assignment. if the serial is bound to the old MDM, FileVault could be escrowed to that tenant. two paths: 1) we can reassign in ABM/Kandji and push a fresh escrow/MDM profile so OOBE proceeds, or 2) if you're blocked, devex can give a temporary local admin after we verify identity.

devex-oliver: I can approve a 1-hour admin session but for a recovery key prompt that won't help until disk is unlocked. prefer ABM fix. can you confirm if packaging says "refurbished"?

noah: laptop tag shows refurb sticker from vendor. happy to wait for ABM fix.

sophia-it: looks like serial is still assigned to our old ABM tenant (pre-migration). i'm reassigning to current Kandji server and clearing previous escrow metadata. pushing enrollment now. i'll post when done.

sophia-it: pushed. reboot the device from recovery and try network install again. if you see a network authentication prompt, connect to "Redwood Onboarding" wifi (use your Okta creds).

noah: rebooted, connected to wifi in recovery, it found the MDM and then asked to allow management profile. after approving, it resumed and FileVault prompt changed to "Enable FileVault" (not recovery key).

noah: enabled FileVault and it asked to store recovery key in company escrow. confirmed escrow. Kandji shows device as managed. :tada:

sophia-it: closing INC-2468. note for infra: flag refurbished vendor images during ABM import to avoid leftover escrows.

devex-oliver: added a short onboarding note: if OOBE asks for recovery key, don't create local admin until IT checks ABM assignment. thanks for patience @noah, welcome aboard!
